knowledgeBoundary.conflictPolicy: 内置项目记忆不覆盖、不替代 LLMWiki/Outline/DeepWiki 唯一知识源：不用它充当 Kp/Kt 回执，不把它的输出当作知识闭合证据；两模式 SKILL 提示的 comet knowledge remember 仅视为缓存便利功能；不能禁用或隔离时不启用冲突功能（不以提示词充当不可绕过性）
knowledgeBoundary.nativeArchiveKnowledgeCheck: state check archive: entry checks 5/5 pass with zero knowledge receipts; envelope never mentions llmwiki/outline — the native gate carries no Kp precondition
knowledgeBoundary.kpEnforcement: driver gate (lib/adapters/comet.js sealCloseout, Knowledge.Closeout.v1: Kp before archive, Kt before overall completion) — reused unmodified from P1_3; enforcement seat for the sole-source boundary

history045.c07Note: state check <phase> is the ENTRY check set of the requested phase (6/6 passed with no build evidence) — it is not an exit gate; exit gating happens at transition/guard/--apply/archive, all of which refuse. Shell/MCP write channels remain an A09 capability gap of the guard hook (recorded by P1_3, re-verified here via the same adapter); the managed downstream gates remain the holding enforcement.
history045.m01Note: M01: the fixed distribution carries the pre-fixed Classic method only; no Superpowers runtime is installed or invoked by managed delivery (docs/superpowers is an upstream artifact root name, not a runtime; assert 'superpowers enabled' absent from comet status output). The 0001-matt-method-profile.patch is part of the pinned build; source references are not a runtime dependency.

observations.observation: state complete-design is the strict design confirmation: when the design doc carries frontmatter it must declare the binding triple comet_change: <change>, role: technical-design, canonical_spec: openspec; without the triple the command refuses (naming 'Design Doc …' checks) AFTER registering the design_doc reference, and `state transition design-complete` is the phase driver (design -> build). Managed use should author the frontmatter triple so the strict path passes (both recipes drive the same gate set).

the build-complete/verify-pass transitions rewrite .comet.yaml and drop the verification_report field when it was recorded before the transition; `state set verification_report` must (re-)run at the verify phase, where the field persists (state set additionally requires the report file to exist). The escape-path probe records this ordering.

comet knowledge remember stores $HOME/Library/Caches/Comet/project-knowledge/<project-hash>/memory/<slug>.md; knowledge list additionally exposes Comet-generated topology records (provider=local). Nothing in either flow touches LLMWiki/Outline/DeepWiki.
